title: Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) – Customer Onboarding für Praxissoftware
description: Berlin | Hybrid Du erklärst gern, behältst bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und packst bei technischen Fragen mit an? Dann begleite Arztpraxen beim Wechsel auf eine neue Software – vom ersten Planungsgespräch bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live. DOMUS Consult sucht für einen Anbieter cloudbasierter Praxisverwaltungssoftware im Raum Berlin einen Onboarding Manager (m/w/d) . Im Customer Onboarding verbindest du Projektmanagement, Technik und persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Dein Ziel: Software Onboarding für Arztpraxen so gestalten, dass Praxisteams gut vorbereitet mit ihrem neuen System arbeiten können. Du machst aus einem Softwarewechsel einen guten Start Du steuerst das gesamte Onboarding von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum Go-live und der anschließenden Übergabe an den Kundenservice. Du lernst die Abläufe und Anforderungen der Praxen kennen und konfigurierst das Praxisverwaltungssystem entsprechend. Du koordinierst die Datenmigration gemeinsam mit dem internen Datenmigrationsteam. Du schulst Ärztinnen, Ärzte, Medizinische Fachangestellte und das Praxismanagement – verständlich und passend zum jeweiligen Wissensstand. Du bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen: Praxisteams, Labore, externe IT-Dienstleister und Anbieter der Telematikinfrastruktur. Du bleibst die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Praxen und gibst Feedback sowie eigene Verbesserungsideen an Produktmanagement und Entwicklung weiter. Du kannst erklären, organisieren und mitdenken Du bringst mindestens ein Jahr Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder mindestens drei Jahre im Customer Service beziehungsweise Customer Success im IT- oder Softwareumfeld mit. Außerdem passt die Rolle zu dir, wenn du: sicher vor Gruppen auftrittst und Freude daran hast, anderen etwas verständlich zu erklären; ein gutes technisches Verständnis mitbringst und bei Hardware- und Netzwerkthemen praktisch mit anpackst; mehrere Projekte strukturiert organisierst und auch bei Hindernissen nach Lösungen suchst; klar und freundlich kommunizierst, gern im Team arbeitest und Verantwortung für deine Ziele übernimmst; den Gesundheitsmarkt kennenlernen möchtest und situativ flexibel bist; verhandlungssicher Deutsch auf Niveau C1/C2 sprichst und gute Englischkenntnisse hast. Zusätzlich hilfreich: Erfahrung mit Praxisverwaltungssystemen oder Praxisabläufen, etwa als MFA, Kenntnisse der Telematikinfrastruktur, Erfahrung als Trainer oder Schulungsleitung sowie Salesforce- oder vergleichbare CRM-Kenntnisse. Das sind Pluspunkte, keine Voraussetzungen. Damit du selbst gut ankommst Dich erwartet eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in das Produkt, den Praxisalltag und die Telematikinfrastruktur. Du arbeitest im Support- und Onboarding-Team eng mit der Teamleitung zusammen und kannst auf kollegiale Unterstützung zählen. Zum Angebot gehören ein Büroarbeitsplatz in Berlin mit teilweiser Homeoffice-Möglichkeit, kurze Entscheidungswege und Gestaltungsspielraum bei der Weiterentwicklung des Onboardings. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, dich im Team weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Warum sich der Wechsel für dich lohnen kann Du begleitest Kundenprojekte vom Anfang bis zum Abschluss und erlebst, wie deine Arbeit im Praxisalltag ankommt. Dabei verbindest du Kundenkontakt, Softwareimplementierung und Kundenschulung. Deine Erfahrungen aus den Projekten fließen in bessere Abläufe und die Weiterentwicklung des Produkts ein. Lass uns über deinen nächsten Schritt sprechen Klingt nach einer Aufgabe für dich? Dann schick deine Bewerbung an Roland Wollburg . DOMUS Consult Wirtschaftsberatung begleitet den Bewerbungsprozess, führt die ersten Interviews und stellt geeignete Profile dem Auftraggeber vor. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere Kunden und nimmst eingehende Telefonate freundlich und professionell entgegen. Du beantwortest allgemeine Kundenanfragen, gibst Auskünfte zum aktuellen Bearbeitungsstand und leitest Anliegen bei Bedarf an die zuständigen Kollegen weiter. Du sorgst dafür, dass Kundenanliegen zuverlässig aufgenommen, dokumentiert und bearbeitet werden. Du bearbeitest eingehende E-Mails und unterstützt bei der allgemeinen Kundenkorrespondenz. Du pflegst Kunden- und Projektdaten in unserem CRM-System. Du unterstützt unser Backoffice bei der Anmeldung von Photovoltaikanlagen bei verschiedenen Netzbetreibern. Du hilfst bei der Vorbereitung, Prüfung und Zusammenstellung von Unterlagen für Netzanmeldungen und Inbetriebnahmen. Du übernimmst die Korrespondenz mit Netzbetreibern und unterstützt bei der Klärung offener Vorgänge. Du koordinierst Termine und stimmst dich mit unseren internen Abteilungen ab. Wichtig: Bei uns geht es ausschließlich um eingehende Kundenanfragen (Inbound). Keine Kaltakquise, keine Verkaufsanrufe und kein Outbound-Callcenter. Das bringst du mit Du hast idealerweise eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, in der Büroorganisation oder im Backoffice. Du telefonierst gerne und hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Kunden. Du kommunizierst freundlich, geduldig und serviceorientiert, auch wenn es einmal stressig wird. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du arbeitest strukturiert, sorgfältig und selbstständig. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit dem PC und gängigen Office-Anwendungen. Du bist zuverlässig, teamfähig und behältst auch bei mehreren gleichzeitigen Anfragen den Überblick. Erste Erfahrungen in der Photovoltaikbranche oder im Umgang mit Netzbetreibern sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Dann freuen wir uns auf dich! Bewirb dich ganz einfach über den Button. Ein Lebenslauf reicht, ein Anschreiben ist nicht nötig. Wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. raw.description:
Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their
logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and
in our hands it is mostly an engineering one.

We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our
infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a
product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and
considers those the same job.

We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is
mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway
management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001.

If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting
things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you
learn every day — then this is the place for you.

The work in front of us

Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a
cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and
grow into the rest.

  • Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on
    technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget.
  • User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies,
    partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app.
  • API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code.
  • Payments and billing.
  • ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging,
    observability and alerting, consent and retention.
  • The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on
    Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access.
  • Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were
    never designed to meet.

Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. We want
someone strong across a good part of it, comfortable being new to the rest, and
used to working things out — with a team and with agents, rather than alone.

Also in daily use: Postgres and PostGIS, Valkey, ClickHouse; Vite, Tailwind and
Radix; Jest and Playwright; GitHub Actions; HAProxy. Most of what we write is
TypeScript, strict — though our core API is Java and Spring, and the identity
layer has Java in it too, so how far you go into that side is up to you.

How we work

LLM-native, in the codebases you would work in. They are built around
agent-assisted development rather than merely tolerant of it — the conventions,
the tooling and the review gates all assume it. Agents do most of the
implementation and much of the review; humans design, verify and approve. What
we are really hiring for is judgement over output you did not write by hand:
knowing what to specify, what to check, and what to throw away. The bar did not
move when the tooling did.

Shape Up, and you own what you take. Roughly three weeks of building, then a
week of cooldown, with bets chosen at a betting table. We are small enough that
an area becomes yours quickly — you make the calls inside it and you answer for
how it turns out. We hand out problems, not the steps that solve them.

Remote first, with most of the team in Europe and everyone together in person at
least twice a year. Significant technical decisions get written down, and a
green build is never on its own enough to merge.

Requirements

You'll thrive here if you have…

  • Senior full-stack experience — you have owned features from the browser to
    the machine they run on.
  • A track record of taking something and running with it — a domain, a
    migration, a subsystem you took on, decided and stayed accountable for.
  • Taste. You can tell a good design from a merely plausible one, and you
    will reject work that functions but is not right — your own, and an agent's.
  • React beyond the client — server rendering, static generation, data
    loading and hydration; you know what runs where and why it matters.
  • TypeScript at strict — typed boundaries, and an instinct for when types
    are carrying real weight.
  • Infrastructure as code — Pulumi ideally; Terraform if you are ready to
    pick up Pulumi.
  • Containers and Linux in production — not writing a Dockerfile, but
    debugging a service on a machine you have to SSH into.
  • Postgres beyond queries — backup and restore, migrations, what a schema
    change does under load.
  • Wholehearted LLM-assisted development — you use coding agents daily, have
    opinions about steering them, and review their output as critically as a
    colleague's.
  • Integration instincts — third-party APIs, webhooks, OAuth/OIDC, and
    patience for other people's undocumented edge cases.
  • A working day that overlaps ours: based within CET ±3.
  • Fluent in English, our working language.

Nice to have

  • Identity and API gateways in depth — Keycloak, OIDC, SAML brokering, APISIX.
  • Compliance from the inside — an ISO 27001 certification lived through, or GDPR
    beyond a cookie banner.
  • Payment systems, billing models, or PSP integrations.
  • Observability and alerting — Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
  • Experience in the maritime, logistics or freight industry.
  • Familiarity with emissions accounting frameworks (GHG Protocol, GLEC, EU
    ETS..).

Benefits

As part of our team, you will:

  • 🌱 Have a chance to re-shape the future of climate in the logistics.
  • 👩‍💻 Be empowered to deliver your best work remotely, and get a stipend to set
    you up.
  • 🏄‍♂️ Have a flat hierarchy, where you will have direct access to the founders
    and won't be tied up in politics.
  • 🎓 Have a high degree of learning and ownership in a dynamic environment.
  • 🏝 Take part in our team-building events.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

When a branch or market team can’t get something done in our systems, they come to you. Our teams work across a connected landscape of internal tools, from first customer contact through offer and project planning to installation and invoicing. You find out why: is it a bug, a gap in knowledge, or a missing feature? Then you make sure the right fix happens and you stay on it until the user can work again. What you see in the tickets helps us make these systems easier to use.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Support branches and market teams in Germany, Australia, Sweden, Denmark, Spain, the Netherlands and Finland, in German and English
  • Diagnose each issue and deliver the matching fix: a guide or training for a knowledge gap, a bug report with reproduction steps for Engineering, a feature request with use case and impact for Product
  • Where a simple automation closes the gap for a bug or a missing feature, you build it yourself. It goes live after a review with Engineering.
  • Use ticket data and the support metrics we agree on (volume by topic, time to resolution, share of repeat requests) to find where time is lost, and propose changes
  • Improve our support setup: ticket categories, templates, routing and handover rules
  • Write and maintain help articles and run onboarding sessions for new users and new markets This role is a good starting point in our tech organisation. You work across the full system landscape and all seven markets, and you learn how Product and Engineering make decisions. From here you can develop in several directions, for example towards product operations, ownership of an internal tool, or automation and engineering.

Dein Profil

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in support, customer success or a similar role. Internships and working student positions count.
  • German and English at C1 level or higher, written and spoken
  • Experience with business software, for example a CRM or ticketing system
  • Good technical understanding of how SaaS tools connect: data fields and objects, user roles and permissions, integrations, APIs and webhooks
  • A structured way of troubleshooting: you can reproduce an issue, narrow down the cause and describe it so that Engineering can act on it without follow-up questions
  • Experience in training or onboarding other people, or in building automations with low-code tools (e.g. n8n, windmill). One of the two is enough.
  • Experience in a startup or scale-up is a plus

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Projektmanagment
description: Du willst im Studentenjob nicht Kaffee kochen und Listen abtippen, sondern an echten Projekten und an einem System arbeiten, das danach dauerhaft anders läuft? Dann lies weiter. Wir sind neaSOL , ein junges, wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Photovoltaik. Wir bauen Photovoltaikanlagen, Speicher, Wallboxen und Energiemanagement – sauber, schnell und auf höchstem technischen Niveau. Und das ist nicht nur so dahingesagt: Von GoodWe , einem der führenden Hersteller weltweit, wurden wir als digitalste und schnellste Firma des Herstellers ausgezeichnet. Genau da setzt deine Rolle an. Du arbeitest direkt an der Seite unseres Projektmanagers : Ihr geht Projekte gemeinsam durch, prüft sie auf Vollständigkeit, Termine und Wirtschaftlichkeit – und du sorgst dafür, dass nichts durchrutscht. Parallel treibst du unser zweites großes Thema voran: unser Warenwirtschaftssystem auf Automatisierungsniveau zu heben . Bestände, Beschaffung, Materialflüsse und Projektzuordnung sollen künftig KI-gestützt und weitgehend automatisch laufen statt manuell gepflegt zu werden. Kurz gesagt: Du behandelst nicht nur die einzelnen Projekte – du behandelst die Warenwirtschaft selbst als Projekt . Wer bei uns Einblick will, wie ein Betrieb Schritt für Schritt KI-basiert aufgestellt wird, bekommt ihn hier aus der ersten Reihe. Aufgaben Projektbegleitung: Du unterstützt unseren Projektmanager im Tagesgeschäft – von der Auftragsübergabe über die Terminierung bis zur Fertigmeldung. Projektprüfung: Du gehst laufende Projekte gemeinsam mit ihm durch: Sind alle Unterlagen da? Stimmen Material, Termine und Kalkulation? Wo hakt es – und warum? Warenwirtschaft automatisieren: Du analysierst, wie unsere Warenwirtschaft heute läuft, findest die manuellen Bremsklötze und baust mit uns den Weg zur Automatisierung. KI & Tools einsetzen: Du testest und implementierst KI-gestützte Lösungen und Schnittstellen – von automatisierten Bestandsabgleichen bis zu Auswertungen, die vorher niemand hatte. Prozesse dokumentieren: Du hältst Abläufe sauber fest, damit aus Wissen im Kopf ein System wird, das auch ohne dich funktioniert. Auswertungen & Reporting: Du bereitest Zahlen so auf, dass Projektmanagement und Geschäftsführung schnell entscheiden können. Qualifikation Du bist eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) – z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Supply Chain / Logistik, Informatik oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang. Wichtiger als der Titel ist, wie du denkst. Du hast Spaß an Prozessen und Systemen und willst verstehen, warum etwas so läuft, wie es läuft – nicht nur, dass es läuft. Digitale Affinität: Excel/Google Sheets sitzen, mit ERP-/Warenwirtschaftssystemen, Automatisierungstools oder KI-Anwendungen hast du schon gearbeitet oder willst es unbedingt. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und verbindlich – wenn du etwas zusagst, kommt es auch. Du bist kommunikativ und traust dich, im Team nachzuhaken, wenn Informationen fehlen. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du hast ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit gerne mehr) und willst länger als ein Semester bleiben. Kein Muss: Vorkenntnisse in Photovoltaik. Die Technik bringen wir dir bei – Kopf und Motivation bringst du mit. Benefits Was wir dir bieten Ein echtes Projekt statt Hilfsjob: Die Automatisierung unserer Warenwirtschaft ist deins – mit Verantwortung, Budgetgesprächen und sichtbarem Ergebnis. Kurze Wege: Du arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement und direkt mit der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen dauern bei uns keine Wochen. Einblick in einen KI-getriebenen Betrieb: Wir stellen unser Unternehmen von Lead bis Rechnung konsequent digital und automatisiert auf. Du bist mittendrin, nicht in der Theorievorlesung. Attraktive Vergütung: [15 € / Stunde] – fair und pünktlich. Flexible Zeiteinteilung , abgestimmt auf deinen Stundenplan und deine Prüfungsphasen. Bestes Equipment: aktuelle Hardware und Software – wir sparen nicht an den Werkzeugen unserer Leute. Ausgezeichnetes Umfeld: von GoodWe als digitalste und schnellste Firma des Herstellers ausgezeichnet. Familiäres, dynamisches Team , das anpackt – inklusive gemeinsamer Team-Events. Perspektive: Wer bei uns liefert, dem machen wir nach dem Studium gerne ein Angebot. Wenn du als Werkstudent Lust hast, diese Einblicke bei uns zu bekommen – melde dich einfach. Bewirb dich unkompliziert über Join. Ein Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze dazu, warum dich das Thema reizt, reichen uns fürs Erste völlig. Zeugnisse und Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Den Rest besprechen wir persönlich. Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns reden. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Content & Digital PR Manager (m/w/d)
description: Vollzeit · Lingen (Ems) · vor Ort · ab sofort Gute Inhalte allein reichen nicht mehr. Google und KI-Systeme wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Claude empfehlen die Marken, über die andere schreiben und denen sie vertrauen. Wer gefunden werden will, braucht beides: starke Inhalte auf der eigenen Website und Präsenz auf den richtigen fremden Websites. Wir sind experics, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Boutique-Agentur für SEO und GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) aus Lingen. Mit über 200 betreuten Websites und Online-Shops, durchschnittlich mehr als 11 Jahren Erfahrung pro Consultant und dem European Search Award 2025 gehören wir zu den erfahrenen Spezialisten für organische Sichtbarkeit in Google und KI-Systemen wie ChatGPT oder Google Gemini. Durch diese Fachkenntnis sorgen wir dafür, dass mittelständische Unternehmen in Google und KI-Systemen gefunden, empfohlen und gekauft werden. Wir suchen dich als Content & Digital PR Manager (m/w/d). Du schreibst Inhalte für die Websites unserer Kunden, die Menschen überzeugen und die Suchmaschinen und KI-Systeme verstehen. Und du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden auch auf externen Websites stattfinden, mit Artikeln, die ihre Reputation und digitale Autorität aufbauen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren SEO- und GEO-Consultants zusammen. Hast du Lust auf diese Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich jetzt! Aufgaben Content für die Websites unserer Kunden Inhalte, die gefunden werden: Du erstellst erstklassige Inhalte für die Websites unserer Kunden: Ratgeber- und Blogartikel, Kategorietexte, Produktbeschreibungen und Landingpages. Immer mit Blick darauf, wie Google und KI-Systeme sie finden, verstehen und zitieren. Recherche und Briefings: Du recherchierst Themen, Suchintentionen und die Fragen der Zielgruppe, erstellst Briefings und stimmst die Inhalte mit unseren Consultants und den Kunden ab. Kundenkontakt: Du bist Ansprechpartner für Content-Themen, holst Fachwissen beim Kunden ab und sorgst dafür, dass Freigaben zügig laufen. Qualität sichern: Du prüfst Inhalte auf Richtigkeit, Stil und SEO/GEO-Anforderungen und überarbeitest bestehende Texte, wenn sie an Wirkung verlieren. Digital PR und Authority Building Quellenportfolio aufbauen: In Abstimmung mit unseren SEO- und GEO-Consultants recherchierst du Websites, Fachmedien und Partnernetzwerke, die thematisch zu unseren Kunden passen. Dazu gehören auch die Quellen, auf die sich KI-Systeme in ihren Antworten stützen und die dir unsere Consultants liefern. Themenplanung: Du entwickelst Themen und Aufhänger, die für Redaktionen und Partner interessant sind und zu den Zielen unserer Kunden passen. Outreach: Du nimmst Kontakt zu Redaktionen und Partner-Websites auf, stimmst Platzierungen ab und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Artikel für externe Platzierungen: Du schreibst PR-Artikel, Fachbeiträge, Informationsartikel und Advertorials, abgestimmt mit den Partnern. Komplette Abwicklung: Von der Planung über Kommunikation und Freigaben bis zur Veröffentlichung und Dokumentation liegt alles bei dir. Qualifikation Erfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Content-Erstellung, Online-Redaktion, PR oder Digital PR mit, idealerweise in einer Agentur. Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsmanagement, PR oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang ist ein Plus. Schreiben: Du schreibst Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau und wechselst sicher zwischen Ratgeber, Produkttext und PR-Artikel. Englisch ist ein Plus. SEO-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Suchintention, Struktur und interne Verlinkung zusammenhängen. Erfahrung mit suchmaschinenoptimierten Texten ist Pflicht, GEO-Wissen bauen wir gemeinsam mit dir aus. PR und Outreach: Du hast schon Redaktionen oder Website-Betreiber angesprochen und Artikel platziert. Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe. Recherche: Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Branchen und Produkte ein und erkennst, was eine Zielgruppe wirklich wissen will. KI-Tools: Du setzt KI-Tools sicher in Recherche und Texterstellung ein und weißt, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Kommunikationsstark und souverän: Im Kundenkontakt und gegenüber Partnern trittst du klar und verbindlich auf. Strukturiert und organisiert: Du behältst bei vielen parallelen Texten, Kontakten und Freigaben den Überblick. Ownership-Mentalität: Ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein ist für dich selbstverständlich. Auf dich kann man sich verlassen. Benefits 30 Tage Urlaub Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Ob private Termine, Sport oder persönliche Verpflichtungen – dank unserer Kernarbeitszeit von 10 bis 15 Uhr kannst du deinen Arbeitstag besser an dein Leben anpassen. Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Du erhältst eine unbefristete Festanstellung - remote oder in unserem Büro in Lingen. Ein früher Einstieg in GEO: Du baust Wissen auf, das am Markt gerade kaum jemand hat Kurze Entscheidungswege: Deine Ideen landen nicht in endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsleitung zusammen und kannst Projekte schnell und eigenverantwortlich umsetzen. Fachwissen mit Zukunft: Du erhältst tiefe Einblicke in SEO, GEO und KI-Suche und baust dir wertvolles Know-how in Bereichen auf, die für das digitale Marketing zunehmend an Bedeutung gewinnen. Zusätzliche Benefits: afs+ Mitgliedschaft, betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Deutschland-Ticket, Corporate Benefits und weitere attraktive Mitarbeiterangebote. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Regelmäßige Team- und Unternehmensevents, bei denen auch der persönliche Austausch nicht zu kurz kommt. Bitte nur bewerben, wenn du: mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in Content, Online-Redaktion oder PR hast schon suchmaschinenoptimierte Texte geschrieben und nachweisbare Erfahrung im Bereich digitaler PR / Outreach hast auf Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau schreibst an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit interessiert bist Schick uns gern 2 bis 3 Arbeitsproben mit, idealerweise einen suchmaschinenoptimierten Text und einen Artikel, den du extern platziert hast. title: Corporate Development Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="an-overview-of-this-role" data-lfile-container="21ea07e5-ded4-47e8-ad92-4ca7b7d6be35" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development &amp; Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development &amp; Strategic Partnerships.</p> <p>This role straddles strategy and M&amp;A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.</p> <p>Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <h3 id="strategy-and-research">Strategy and research</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the wider market view.</strong> Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.</li> <li><strong>Build an investment thesis for each focus area.</strong> Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.</li> <li><strong>Own the competitive and landscape view.</strong> Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&amp;A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Define where GitLab should not play.</strong> Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.</li> </ul> <h3 id="build-buy-or-partner">Build, buy or partner</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Run the build, buy, partner analysis.</strong> For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.</li> <li><strong>Deliver strategic clarity to</strong> <strong>executives and the Board.</strong> Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.</li> <li><strong>Feed company strategy and planning.</strong> Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.</li> <li><strong>Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships.</strong> When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.</li> </ul> <h3 id="deal-execution-and-integration">Deal execution and integration</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own end-to-end deal process management.</strong> Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. Drive our M&amp;A process from intro call through the various steps through to closing and integration.</li> <li><strong>Evaluate the deal.</strong> Develop valuation, commercial integrity assessment, impact on GitLab's business and provide negotiations assistance to the VP and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Lead cross-functional diligence.</strong> Run pre-LOI validation and diligence across Product, Engineering, Security, Finance, Legal and People, and communicate findings clearly.</li> <li><strong>Drive deal documents with Legal.</strong> Prepare NDAs, LOIs and purchase agreements with GitLab Legal and outside counsel.</li> <li><strong>Own integration outcomes.</strong> Lead post-acquisition integration as the DRI, measured against the roadmap and business goals in the business case. Bring lessons learned back into the strategy work.</li> <li><strong>Build the external network.</strong> Maintain relationships with founders, executives, investors, bankers and advisors that bring us early insight and pipeline.</li> </ul> <h2 id="what-youll-bring">What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strategy and deal experience.</strong> 8+ years across corporate development, corporate strategy, strategy consulting or technology investing, including 5+ years leading acquisitions end to end in enterprise software.</li> <li><strong>Structured strategic thinking.</strong> You form a point of view from incomplete information, test it against data, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You're as comfortable recommending that we stay out of a market as that we enter it.</li> <li><strong>Market research depth.</strong> Skilled in market sizing, competitive analysis and landscape mapping, and in turning research into a recommendation, not a report.</li> <li><strong>Deal craft.</strong> Skilled in valuation, financial modeling, deal structuring, negotiation and integration planning, with experience across varied consideration structures.</li> <li><strong>Technical fluency.</strong> A working understanding of software development, DevSecOps and the AI landscape, enough to hold substantive conversations with product and engineering leaders about roadmaps and architecture.</li> <li><strong>Clear executive communication.</strong> You write short, decision-ready updates and present trade-offs plainly to executives and the Board, in an async-first environment.</li> <li><strong>Influence without authority.</strong> You build trust across Product, Engineering, Finance and Legal and move decisions forward across functions.</li> <li><strong>Ownership with collaboration.</strong> You own the strategic view and the recommendation, and partner closely with the team's Analyst on research and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Preferred:</strong> familiarity with the DevSecOps, security, AI and open source ecosystems.</li> <li>You value the <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/all-remote/" target="_blank">all remote</a> lifestyle and share our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/" target="_blank">values</a>.</li> </ul> <h2 id="about-the-team">About the team</h2> <p>The Corporate Development &amp; Strategic Partnerships team helps GitLab decide how to grow beyond what we build on our own. We own inorganic strategy: acquisitions, strategic partnerships with hyperscalers and AI labs, and the research that tells us which to pursue and which to pass on.</p> <p>We work across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal and the executive group. We set direction and do the detailed work ourselves, with a high degree of ownership and transparency in a fully remote, asynchronous environment.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><a href="https://fin.ai/">Fin</a>, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.</p> <p>Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h3><strong>What’s the opportunity?</strong></h3> <p>We’re hiring an <strong>Engineering Manager</strong> for our <strong>Product Workstreams</strong> in the <strong>AI Group</strong>. The AI Group’s product workstreams, partner with the wider product org to build the AI capabilities that underpin Fin. These workstreams do not act as ‘AI services’ for the wider org; they are instrumental in shaping AI products from the earliest stages and owning their ongoing development. Product workstreams are composed of EMs, PMs, Engineers, AI Designers, and Machine Learning Scientists.</p> <p>You will lead our Berlin-based product engineers in the AI Group and will be a key leader of our Berlin hub, helping it grow. You will also work across Fin's core capabilities, such as Skills, Personalisation, Procedures and Safety, and contribute directly to delivering new Fin products from inception.</p> <p>This is a&nbsp;<strong>hands-on</strong> EM role. You will lead a senior team of engineers and stay hands-on in the codebase. An EM who regularly works alongside ICs builds the context to make good strategic decisions and to support engineers well. Contributing to Fin’s central AI system, architecture and experimentation are core to the job.&nbsp;</p> <p>Learn more about Fin's AI engineering and research at<a href="https://fin.ai/research"> </a>Fin <a href="https://fin.ai/research">/research</a>, and more about Fin at<a href="http://fin.ai"> fin.ai</a>.</p> <h3><strong>What will I be doing?</strong></h3> <p>As a hands-on leader, you will:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and grow a high-performing engineering team </strong>based primarily in Berlin, with members across our European offices.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and deliver AI products </strong>from ideation through to success, leveraging backtests, evals and A/B tests to inform what ships.</li> <li><strong>Contribute directly to our production systems</strong> so you keep first-hand context.</li> <li><strong>Own operational health</strong> for your workstreams: SLOs, alarms, and proactive management of our most critical systems.</li> <li><strong>Plan, prioritise and deliver</strong> best-in-class AI products with your most senior engineers, ML Scientists, PMs and AI Designers.</li> <li><strong>Make AI-first the team default.</strong> Build shared skills, agents, and automations that raise the bar for the team’s output and ambition.</li> <li><strong>Hire and onboard</strong> great engineers, and help them build the Berlin office.</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need?</h2> <p>Must-haves:</p> <ul> <li>Strong prior experience as an engineer, with recent hands-on technical contributions.</li> <li>Strong technical judgement, and the ability to coach senior engineers through complex architecture and product trade-offs.</li> <li>Strong product sense: you can weigh AI product opportunities and decide what matters most.</li> <li>A data-driven approach: you use experiments and metrics to make decisions.</li> <li>Strong ownership of production quality and reliability.</li> <li>An adaptable leadership style for a group and environment that will grow fast and change shape.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Nice to haves:</p> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering teams that build and operate generative AI systems in production.</li> <li>Experience with AI evaluation, backtesting or experiment design at scale.</li> <li>Experience managing AI costs and how product choices affect it.</li> <li>Experience in a hands-on EM role, or alternating between EM and IC roles.</li> <li>Experience helping build or grow a new engineering site.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h2>How will I be supported?</h2> <ul> <li>You’ll have a structured onboarding experience to help you get up to speed quickly in Berlin and across Intercom.</li> <li>You’ll have a close group of management peers to collaborate with and learn from.</li> <li>We invest in our managers, supporting individual career development through training, coaching and regular feedback.</li> <li>You’ll have opportunities to contribute to and learn from our wider engineering community.</li> </ul> <h2>Benefits</h2> <p>We’re a well-treated bunch, with awesome benefits. If there’s something important to you that’s not on this list, talk to us.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary and equity in a fast-growing company.</li> <li>A flexible, hybrid way of working from our Berlin location.</li> <li>Regular compensation reviews—we reward great work.</li> <li>Health, wellbeing and insurance benefits designed for our employees in Germany.</li> <li>Family-friendly leave and support in line with local requirements and company policy.</li> <li>Flexible time off so you can take a break when you need it.</li> <li>A well-equipped Berlin office, including lunch and kitchen provisions.</li> <li>A MacBook as standard, with flexibility to choose the equipment that helps you do your best work.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Policies&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. description: <div class="content-intro"><p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.</p> <p>We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.</p></div><p><a style="display: block; overflow: hidden; position: relative;" href="https://share.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f" target="_blank"> <img style="width: 100%; display: block; max-width: 100%;" src="https://image.synthesia.io/35a0c2a2-c772-4d2a-b571-808b7462c25f/thumbnail.gif" alt="Inside the Life of a Zscaler Enterprise Account Executive"> </a></p> <p><strong>Role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Account Executive to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Germany, reporting to the Sales Director in the Enterprise sales department. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. In this role, you will take ownership of an assigned territory to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do (Role Expectations)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take ownership of an assigned territory in Germany focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities with Enterprise prospects and customers</li> <li>Demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of your customer and prospect organizations</li> <li>Generate pipeline using new techniques, tools, joint field marketing initiatives, and top-tier channel partners including VAR, SI, and SP</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are (Success Profile)</strong></p> <ul> <li>You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.</li> <li>You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.</li> <li>You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.</li> <li>You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.</li> <li>You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain</li> <li>3+ years of sales experience with a revenue quota, selling to Enterprise accounts in Germany</li> <li>History of net new logo accomplishments and a clear understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships</li> <li>Willingness to be coached and the discipline to work a proven sales process from beginning to end</li> <li>Evidence of successful "team sales" and the ability to leverage internal resources and partners</li> <li>Fluency in German</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence, predictive forecasting, or conversational AI platforms to optimize enterprise territory planning and pipeline acceleration</li> <li>Proficiency in strategic sales planning with experience closing net new logos</li> <li>A consistent track record of winning business in Enterprise accounts</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid #LI-MM5</p> <p><br><br></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span data-sheets-root="1">Zscaler’s salary ranges are benchmarked and determined by role and level. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.</p> <p>Our Benefits program is one of the most important ways we support our employees. Zscaler proudly offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families throughout their life stages, including:</p> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <ul> <li>Various health plans</li> <li>Time off plans for vacation and sick time</li> <li>Parental leave options</li> <li>Retirement options</li> <li>Education reimbursement</li> <li>In-office perks, and more!</li> </ul> <div class="has-nudge" data-nudge-id="5eb9419b-6a4d-4451-bfa6-e2eb96084be0"> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">Learn more about Zscaler's hybrid working model and benefits&nbsp;<a href="https://www.zscaler.com/candidate-resource-hub" target="_blank">here</a>.</p> </div> </div> <p>By applying for this role, you adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and Zscaler policies, including those related to security and privacy standards and guidelines.</p> <p class="p1">Zscaler is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Pre-Sales Solutions Architect, you'll design complex solutions to demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services to help organizations within the German Defense and Intelligence community overcome their earth data challenges. You'll collaborate with internal cross-functional teams, including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development, to act as the voice of the customer and enhance Planet's industry offerings.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are dedicated to earth observation and enabling customer success across complex technical projects.</p> <p><span style="color: #000000; background-color: transparent;">This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.</span></p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and deliver presentations and product demonstrations highlighting technical capabilities of Planet’s platform and our ability to fulfill customer’s business needs.</li> <li>Build relationships with customers’ technical and management staff as a trusted advisor to their business.</li> <li>Act as a technical advisor to the customer to recommend a solutions architecture that fits their business challenges.</li> <li>Craft the technical response to tenders, RFI’s/RFP’s, and unsolicited proposals with respect to Planet’s products and solutions.</li> <li>Partner with your sales team colleagues to architect and drive the technical strategy across customer and prospect account plans.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborate with internal cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Product Management, and Business Development to act as the voice of the customer, assist with RFP and RFI preparation and submissions.&nbsp;</li> <li>Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.</li> <li>Represent the needs of Planet's Defense and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback.&nbsp;</li> <li>Present to key executive Government stakeholders within the German Government&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentors junior team members and contributes to team training materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience supporting the German Defense and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.</li> <li>Ability to travel, including internationally, up to 25%.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills in the German language.</li> <li>Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</li> <li>Experience working with GIS and Remote Sensing users within the Defense industry.</li> <li>Experience in IMINT, ISR, and related fields.</li> <li>Experience with QGIS, SocetGXP, ArcGIS, GDAL, Python, and other geospatial software packages and programming languages.</li> <li>Experience designing and presenting complex systems and solutions that bridge the gap between business problems and technology to meet organizational goals, budget, and scalability needs.</li> <li>Ability to communicate and coordinate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Ability to process imagery, manipulate geospatial data, interact with APIs, and build data pipelines.</li> <li>Obtaining and maintaining eligibility for a German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung) is required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a dynamic environment.</li> <li>Experience leading technical customer engagements and leading workshops or training sessions with users.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. That’s why Planet is guided by an ultimate north star of Belonging—dreaming big as we approach our ongoing work.&nbsp; If this job intrigues you, but you’re thinking you might not have all the qualifications, please... do apply!&nbsp; At Planet, we are looking for well-rounded people from around the world who can contribute to more ways than just what is listed in this job description.&nbsp; We don’t just fill positions, we aspire to fulfill people’s careers, most excited about folks who are motivated by our underlying humanitarian efforts.&nbsp; We are a few orbits around the sun before we get to where we want to be, so we hope you’re excited to come along for the ride.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>EEO statement: <br></strong>Planet is committed to building a community where everyone belongs and we invite people from all backgrounds to apply. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><h4><strong>The Team:</strong></h4> <p>You will join a high-performing sales team within the DACH sales organization, responsible for driving growth within large global enterprises from the Transportation &amp; Logistics industry, including rail, ocean shipping and contract logistics. Land-and-expand is the typical model.</li> <li>Engage across lines of business, at C-level and below.</li> <li>Drive Celonis Process Intelligence sales motions across the logistics value chain and translate customer challenges into compelling, AI-enabled use cases with measurable impact.</li> <li>Hold an individual revenue target for closing six- to seven-figure deals within your accounts.</li> <li>Navigate complex procurement and tender processes.</li> <li>Engage closely with partners, e.g. consulting firms and SaaS vendors.</li> <li>Drive complex sales cycles by orchestrating virtual teams: business development representatives, marketing managers, partner managers, value engineers, sales engineers / pre-sales, customer success managers, professional services and implementation partners.</li> </ul> <h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h4><strong>The Qualifications you need:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>8+ years of relevant experience in either one, or ideally both, of the following domains:</li> <ul> business development, including your own sales target and sourcing new projects.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise Software Sales: </strong>a proven track record of applying a consultative sales approach to sell complex, strategic business solutions to large enterprise accounts with full account ownership, ideally at a hyperscaler or leading SaaS company.</li> </ul> <li>A proven track record of commitment, long tenure and successful career progression with your previous companies.</li> <li>Strong business acumen and a deep understanding of how transportation and logistics companies operate, with familiarity with their core processes and KPIs, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance.</li> <li>Familiarity with the different industry players (3PL, contract logistics, freight forwarding, rail) and experience in addressing their key challenges: supply chain volatility and resilience, cost pressure (e.g. from manual document handling such as customs and air waybills), and punctuality.</li> <li>Proven ability to build trusted relationships with senior Business and IT stakeholders and engage effectively at the C-level (CEO, CFO, CIO, COO, Head of Operations).</li> <li>Experience with complex tender processes is a strong plus.</li> <li>Grit, a hands-on mindset, and strong discovery and sales process leadership.</li> <li>Fluency in German and English, with exceptional communication and presentation skills.</li> <li>Ability to adapt to a fast-moving, high-growth environment and approach challenges with positivity, creative thinking and a growth mindset.</li> <li>Willingness to be collaborative and inclusive, to embrace diversity, and strong interpersonal skills #differentmakesusbetter</li> <li>Ability to leverage internal resources and work as a team #bestteamwins</li> </ul> <p>#LI-SS6</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>What Celonis can offer you:</strong></p> <ul class="p-rich_text_list p-rich_text_list__bullet the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Ownership from Day 1:</span> Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Unrivaled Family Support:</span> Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Work-Life Integration:</span> Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Continuous Growth:</span> Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Holistic Well-being:</span> Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Drive Sustainability:</span> Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Global Inclusion &amp; Belonging:</span> Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.</li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Value-Driven Impact:</span> Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.</li> title: Senior Software Engineer, Operations Foundations
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>Wolt is looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Front-end-leaning) to join our Operations Foundations team. The team sits within the DoorDash Client and AI Development group and is responsible for the foundation that hundreds of engineers across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo rely on to build internal operations tools. Our platform hosts 250+ micro-frontends (MFEs) used to operate every part of the business.</p> <p>Our team is focused on building a scalable, reliable, and high-quality internal tooling platform that supports Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo’s operations and business.</p> <p>The team plays an important role in improving how engineers build, test, and ship software across the organization, with a strong emphasis on reusable libraries, micro-frontend architecture, and agentic development: building the platform where AI agents can take changes from task to merged PR safely and reliably without lowering the quality bar.</p> <p>Currently, we are focused on unifying our frontend platforms, evolving shared components and library development, improving developer productivity, and enabling teams to deliver more independently through better architecture and tooling.</p> <p>It’s an exciting time to join because the team has strong ownership and a broad technical impact.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can take ownership of complex technical initiatives across both frontend and sometimes backend and infra domains. title: Director Solutions Platform, UK
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><h3><strong>Role Purpose</strong></h3> <p>The Platform Operations Director is responsible for ensuring that solutions developed and released for the Solutions team are operationally ready, properly tested, clearly documented, effectively released, and provide support once live.</p> <p>The role acts as the bridge between delivery, business readiness and BAU operations. It supports the transition of work from project delivery into stable operational use, ensuring that users, stakeholders and support teams understand what has changed, how to use it, how to raise issues, and how ongoing support will be managed with appropriate priority, impact and SLAs</p> <p>This role is particularly important as Solutions Integration moves from a more reactive service model into a structured product and agile delivery function. The Platform Operations Director owns QA, release management, documentation, stakeholder communication, support processes, training, adoption and post-release improvement including BAU bugs and triage.</p> <p>The role works closely with Product Owners, Scrum Master, Engineering, Data, Reporting, QA, Platform Operations, and business stakeholders to make sure delivery does not stop at “built”, but continues through testing, launch, adoption, support and measurable operational value.</p> <h2><strong>Senior / Specialist-Level Expectations</strong></h2> <p>As a Director within the team, this role is expected to help define and improve the operating standards around BAU management, QA coordination, release readiness, business readiness and service transition. Manage and proactively manage risk, resolution SLAs and ensure we are adhering to platform operational best practices.</p> <p>The Platform Operations Director should be able to identify operational risks early, challenge whether a solution is genuinely ready for release, and recommend practical improvements to processes, documentation, testing, support models and stakeholder communications.</p> <p>For smaller initiatives, the role should be able to advise Product Owners and delivery teams on the appropriate level of QA, training, release planning, handover and BAU support required. For larger or more complex initiatives, the role should escalate risks, dependencies or readiness gaps to the Product Manager Lead, Scrum Master, Lead Engineer / Solutions Architect or relevant leadership stakeholders.</p> <h1><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h1> <h2><strong>1. BAU Operations Management</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own and coordinate BAU operational processes for assigned platforms, tools, reports, workflows and solutions across all Media solutions.</li> <li>Monitor recurring issues, support trends, operational risks and user pain points.</li> <li>Triage and prioritise BAU requests, incidents, defects and enhancement requests.</li> <li>Ensure BAU work is captured through the agreed intake and backlog process rather than unmanaged emails, verbal requests or fragmented ticket routes.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners and the Scrum Master to distinguish between BAU support, defects, enhancements and new product requirements.</li> <li>Maintain visibility of BAU demand and help identify where recurring issues should become product improvements or engineering fixes.</li> <li>Support continuous improvement of support processes, documentation and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p>This links directly to the team’s wider shift away from fragmented request routes and towards clearer delivery rhythms, structured backlogs and improved operational process discipline. The existing documentation notes the need for clearer team rhythms, sprint cadences, retrospectives and mentoring as part of the transition plan .</p> <h2><strong>2. QA Coordination and Testing Readiness</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Coordinate QA activity across delivery workstreams, ensuring testing requirements are understood before development begins.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners to ensure acceptance criteria, test scenarios and success measures are clearly defined.</li> <li>Support test planning across functional testing, regression testing, data validation, reporting checks and user acceptance testing.</li> <li>Ensure defects are logged, prioritised, tracked and resolved through the agreed delivery process.</li> <li>Work with engineers, analysts and business users to validate that solutions meet functional, operational and reporting requirements.</li> <li>Support the creation of reusable QA checklists, test scripts and validation templates.</li> <li>Ensure solutions are not released without appropriate testing evidence and business sign-off.</li> </ul> <p>This is consistent with the Product Owner responsibilities already defined around testing requirements, success criteria, UAT coordination, business validation, release readiness and operational handover . The Platform Operations Specialist would support and operationalise those activities.</p> <h2><strong>3. Business Readiness and Adoption</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ensure business users and operational teams are ready to adopt new or changed solutions.</li> <li>Coordinate training, guidance, demos, FAQs, release notes and user communications.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners to identify impacted teams, users, processes and workflows.</li> <li>Confirm that business teams understand what is changing, why it is changing, when it is happening and what action is required.</li> <li>Support stakeholder communications before, during and after release.</li> <li>Gather early feedback from users and ensure issues are captured and prioritised appropriately.</li> <li>Help ensure delivered solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations, rather than remaining underused or misunderstood.</li> </ul> <p>The handover documentation highlights the importance of clear communication with users, proper release notes, demonstrations and adoption support for new features and solutions . This role should own the operational discipline around making that happen consistently.</p> <h2><strong>4. Release Readiness and Service Transition</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own or coordinate release readiness checklists for assigned solutions.</li> <li>Ensure each release has appropriate testing evidence, documentation, support ownership, training material and stakeholder communication.</li> <li>Coordinate operational handover from delivery teams into BAU support.</li> <li>Confirm that runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known issues and escalation routes are in place.</li> <li>Work with engineering and data teams to ensure monitoring, alerting or manual checks are defined where required.</li> <li>Support go-live planning, release scheduling and post-release hypercare.</li> <li>Track post-release issues and ensure learnings are fed back into future delivery cycles.</li> </ul> <p>This role should become the person asking:</p> <p>“Are we actually ready to put this live, support it, explain it, and measure whether it worked?”</p> <h2><strong>5. Documentation and Knowledge Management</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Maintain clear operational documentation for platforms, reports, tools, processes and workflows.</li> <li>Support the creation of user guides, SOPs, runbooks, release notes, FAQs and support documentation.</li> <li>Ensure documentation is stored in the agreed location and kept up to date.</li> <li>Work with Product Owners, engineers and analysts to document key dependencies, business rules, known limitations and support processes.</li> <li>Help reduce reliance on individual knowledge by making processes and system behaviour transparent.</li> <li>Support onboarding of new team members by maintaining accessible knowledge resources.</li> </ul> <p>This is important because the team is moving away from legacy ways of working and informal knowledge transfer into a more structured operating model.</p> <h2><strong>6. Platform and Process Governance</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Support the consistent use of agreed tools, workflows, ticketing processes and delivery governance.</li> <li>Help ensure work is captured, categorised and progressed through the correct routes.</li> <li>Maintain standards for BAU tickets, defects, release requests, support issues and operational change.</li> <li>Identify process gaps, duplicated effort or inconsistent ways of working.</li> <li>Recommend improvements to BAU processes, support models, QA standards and release governance.</li> <li>Support reporting on operational performance, support demand, defect trends and release readiness.</li> <li>Help ensure changes are controlled, documented and aligned to agreed team practices.</li> </ul> <p>This aligns with the documented need to improve proactive behaviour, structured product management, backlog grooming, stand-ups and retrospectives across the team .</p> <h2><strong>7. Stakeholder and Cross-Team Coordination</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Data, Reporting, QA, Scrum Master and business users.</li> <li>Coordinate with Activation, Operations, Channel Development, Commercial and other impacted teams where relevant.</li> <li>Ensure operational dependencies are understood and managed before release.</li> <li>Help stakeholders understand support routes, known issues, timelines and release impacts.</li> <li>Escalate operational risks, unresolved defects, readiness gaps or business adoption concerns.</li> <li>Support regular BAU and platform operations updates for leadership where required.</li> </ul> <p>The existing Product Owner documentation already describes the importance of coordination across engineering, data, reporting, platform, operations and business teams . The Platform Operations Specialist should provide the operational control layer that supports this.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h1><strong>&nbsp;</strong></h1> <h1><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></h1> <h2><strong>Essential</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience in platform operations, service transition, QA coordination, business readiness, delivery operations or technical operations.</li> <li>Strong understanding of BAU support processes, release management and operational handover.</li> <li>Experience coordinating UAT, defect tracking, test planning or business validation activity.</li> to communicate clearly with users, delivery teams and senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Desirable</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience working in media, advertising, ad tech, martech, reporting, data or platform environments.</li> <li>Experience supporting reporting platforms, dashboards, data products or operational workflow tools.</li> <li>Understanding of data validation, reporting QA or campaign performance data.</li> <li>Familiarity with cloud-based platforms such as GCP, AWS, BigQuery or Snowflake.</li> <li>Experience working with engineering, data engineering or analytics teams.</li> <li>Experience supporting transformation from reactive support models into structured product or agile delivery models.</li> <li>Familiarity with WPP, WPP Media, Choreograph or
