raw.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.


Role overview

As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social, you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market.

You connect that work to measurable business outcomes, improving conversion and return on investment while making sure every health claim is accurate and approved.

Reporting to the Head of Performance Marketing, you will play a key role in our performance marketing team, working with internal teams and external partners to drive growth.

Work location: Our company operates on a remote-first model. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in Europe. Fluent English and German are a must. Occasional travel to our office in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, or to team events may be required.

Core responsibilities

  • Lead paid social strategy, planning and execution across the US, UK, Germany and other growth markets.
  • Develop creative hypotheses based on customer research, market differences and performance data.
  • Brief, test and refine ad concepts, messages, formats and landing pages in partnership with creative and product teams.
  • Manage campaign budgets, audiences and optimisation across Meta, TikTok and other relevant platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey and conversion rate, from ad click through to purchase.
  • Measure performance against acquisition cost, revenue and return on investment and turn findings into clear decisions and next steps.
  • Work with clinical, regulatory and legal colleagues to ensure advertising claims and health messaging are accurate and approved.
  • Steer agencies and freelancers, set clear priorities and ensure high-quality execution and continuous performance improvement.

Requirements

Background & Experience

  • At least 5 years of hands-on paid social experience in an international setting, including direct ownership of campaigns and budgets.
  • Strong creative strategy skills and a track record of turning insights into ads that perform.
  • A data-driven approach to testing, measurement, and decision-making.
  • Experience improving conversion rates and managing campaigns against ROI goals.
  • Deep knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and experience with other relevant social platforms.
  • Ability to adapt messaging and execution across markets while keeping the brand consistent.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment when working with sensitive health topics.
  • Nice to have: experience in health tech, medical devices, wearables, or subscription products.

Benefits

What Makes You A Great Fit

At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do: 

Move the Needle — You focus on what truly drives impact for our customers and company. You use data and clarity to guide your decisions and prioritize what matters most. You push boundaries with bold, thoughtful innovation and hold yourself accountable for results.

Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with high quality. You treat mistakes as learning opportunities, experiment thoughtfully and iterate quickly. You take ownership, act hands-on and always look for smarter, faster ways to get things done, including leveraging AI and new tools.

Team First — You put the team above individual interests, building trust through openness and respect. You encourage healthy debate, challenge directly while caring personally and stand behind team decisions. You act as an owner, stepping in when needed and doing what’s necessary for the team’s success.

Why Join Us?

  • Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies and you can be part of this exciting story.
  • Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.
  • Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate and talented team.
  • Competitive compensation, equity program and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

Die Global Clinical Supply Chain Organisation ist verantwortlich für die kosteneffiziente und termingerechte Herstellung von klinischen Prüfpräparaten (IMPs), sodass keine klinische Studie verzögert wird und jede Patientin und jeder Patient ihre bzw. seine qualitativ hochwertige Behandlung erhält.


Die/Der Site SHE Coordinator ist für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer übergeordneten Strategie für die Themen Arbeitssicherheit, Schutz, Gesundheit und Umwelt verantwortlich. Sie/Er koordiniert diese Themen standortweit.


Die/Der Site SHE Coordinator arbeitet eng mit den Business Partnern für Arbeitssicherheit & Gesundheitsschutz, verschiedenen Abteilungen innerhalb der PTDS-Organisation sowie weiteren Standortteams über die Organisation hinaus zusammen, um Abstimmungen zu erzielen und Best Practices auszutauschen.


Darüber hinaus dient sie/er als Ansprechperson der GCSC-Organisation für die ASGS Business Partner bei der Überwachung der Arbeitssicherheit (inklusive Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz) und ist für die Koordinierung von Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit kontrollierten Substanzen/Betäubungsmitteln und Chemikalien innerhalb von Clinical Supply KAU zuständig.

Arbeitszeiten

Standard, 40h / Woche, HO nach Absprache - mehrheitlich Einsatz vor Ort

Workload

60%

Aufgaben

Übernahme der vollen Verantwortung für die SHE-Aktivitäten der klinischen Lieferkette innerhalb der Global Clinical Supply Chain Organization, KAU, Mitgestaltung der strategischen Ausrichtung der klinischen Versorgungs- und Betriebsorganisation hinsichtlich SHE-Aktivitäten und -Ziele in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den wichtigsten Stakeholdern und dem Leadership-Team, Koordination entsprechender Aktivitäten und Initiativen in enger Kooperation mit verschiedenen PTDS-Bereichen sowie lokalen Schnittstellen, Moderation/Durchführung von Risikobeurteilungen und Sicherstellung der kontinuierlichen Pflege des SHE-Risikomanagements, Förderung der globalen Abstimmung, Standardisierung und Harmonisierung zwischen der klinischen Versorgungsorganisation und anderen PT-Funktionen, wo dies für das gesamte klinische Versorgungsnetzwerk von Vorteil ist, Sicherstellung und Förderung der Gebäude- und Betriebssicherheit als Gebäudebeauftragter für Sicherheit und Umweltschutz (GBSU) für Gebäude 204, einschließlich der aktiven Nachverfolgung von Vorfällen, Entwicklung, Pflege und Überwachung des etablierten SHE-Programms, Sicherstellung des Wissens und des Bewusstseins für SHE-relevante Themen bei allen Mitarbeitenden, Unterstützung der Überwachung der Arbeitssicherheit (inklusive Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz) als Hauptansprechperson für die ASGS Business Partner innerhalb der klinischen Verpackung und Lagerhaltung, Wahrnehmung der Aufsichtsfunktion für Gesundheitsschutz, Umweltschutz, Betäubungsmittel („BTM-Beauftragter“) und Chemikalien („Chemikalienbeauftragter“), Aktive Förderung einer Kultur des Wissensaustauschs und der Zusammenarbeit durch die Weitergabe von Fachwissen und die Beratung von Teammitgliedern in der gesamten Organisation zu SHE-Themen

Qualifikationen

Mehr als 5 Jahre operative Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Industrie oder einem ähnlichen Umfeld (*****), Hochschulabschluss (Bachelor, Master, MBA) in Pharmatechnik, einer relevanten naturwissenschaftlichen Disziplin oder einem vergleichbaren Fachbereich, oder Technische Ausbildung/Qualifikation (z. B. Techniker/Meister) mit mehrjähriger relevanter Berufserfahrung Berufserfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion oder Verpackung, Fundierte Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Herstellung, Verpackung, Qualitätssicherung, Compliance oder Supply Chain, Gutes Verständnis von regulatorischen und qualitätsbezogenen Anforderungen sowie von Best Practices der Branche und Methoden zur Produktionseffizienz (5S, Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma etc.), Gutes Verständnis von SHE-Anforderungen und -Richtlinien (*****), Nachgewiesene effektive Zusammenarbeit über Kulturen und Standorte hinweg mit der Fähigkeit, Abstimmungen herbeizuführen, Fähigkeit zur proaktiven und wirksamen Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und anderen Schnittstellen zur unternehmensweiten Ergebnisoptimierung, Exzellente mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikations- sowie Präsentationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (*****), Fähigkeit, ein funktionsübergreifendes Projekt- und Schwerpunktthemen-Team mit Flexibilität, Handlungsspielraum (Empowerment) und Authentizität zu führen (*****), Eigenverantwortlicher, gut organisierter, flexibler und kundenorientierter Teamplayer, der in der Lage ist, Problemlösungen, Themenmanagement und Entscheidungsfindungen voranzutreiben, Englisch und Deutsch fliessend

Nice to haves

Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeitenden in einer Matrix- oder funktionalen Struktur ist ein Plus, Erfahrung mit der Arbeit in agilen Organisationsmodellen, Solides Verständnis von pharmazeutischen Herstellungs- und Verpackungsprozessen, Abläufen in der klinischen Lieferkette, der Arzneimittelentwicklung sowie von Studiendesigns für klinische Prüfungen ist von Vorteil, Weiterbildung / Zertifizierung in Operational Excellence / Six Sigma / Lean, GMP oder Supply Chain ist ein Plus

coordinate specialist security reviews and work with Systems/RAMS on vehicle interfaces and safety consequences. - Technical Guidance & Mentoring: Review implementations, share practical software-engineering practices and mentor colleagues to strengthen consistency, maintainability and technical ownership across the team. - Tools & Data: Develop tools for configuration, testing, diagnostics, data acquisition and analysis that support engineering and field activities. - Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintain clear software and interface documentation and improve existing code as Traila products mature from development into deployed systems. What you bring - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical technical experience. - Hands-on professional software-development experience in an industrial, automation, automotive, machinery or comparable technical environment. - Proven professional railway software experience, including products released and maintained in service. - Strong practical programming skills in C++, C#, Python or a comparable industrial software stack; you do not need to be an expert in every language listed. - Experience developing software that interacts with real hardware, devices or physical systems. - Experience taking software beyond prototypes into tested, maintainable and deployable industrial use. - Practical railway software lifecycle experience aligned with EN 50716:2023, including requirements traceability, configuration management and verification/validation appropriate to the required software integrity level; relevant EN 50128 / EN 50657 predecessor experience is also valuable. - Practical embedded or industrial cybersecurity experience, including secure credentials and access, signed software updates and rollback, and handling vulnerabilities in released products. - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across software, communication and hardware interfaces. - Experience with Git and structured software-development workflows. - A practical ownership mindset: comfortable working directly with prototypes, test equipment and deployed systems and driving technical problems through to resolution. - Ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines and communicate technical issues clearly. - Fluent English; German is a strong advantage. Nice to have - Experience with industrial Linux, embedded Linux, automation or control systems. - MATLAB/Simulink, HIL/SIL testing, data acquisition or condition-monitoring experience. - Working knowledge of railway cybersecurity under CLC/TS 50701:2023 and of EN IEC 62443-4-1 (secure development) and EN IEC 62443-4-2 (component security) is desirable. - Familiarity with EN 50155 and EN 50126 for equipment integration and collaboration with Systems/RAMS. - Experience in a regulated or safety-relevant product-development environment. Benefits 25 days of annual leave, plus paid bridge days at Christmas. Flexible working hours and home office options. Annual professional development allowance for courses, certifications and conferences. Competitive compensation with milestone bonus scheme and full Swiss social coverage. A collaborative team culture with regular social and sports activities. Real autonomy and short decision-making paths. raw.title: Senior Director, Patient Advocacy & Communications Lead, EMEA
raw.description:
Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need.

As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.

 
Summary of Position:

The Patient Advocacy & Corporate Communications Lead, EMEA will be responsible for developing and executing integrated patient advocacy and communications strategies that advance the company's mission, strengthen stakeholder trust, and support business objectives across the region, starting with Spinal Muscular Atrophy (SMA) and including  facioscapulohumeral dystrophy (FSHD) in line with clinical development milestones. 

This role will serve as the primary EMEA lead for patient advocacy engagement while also driving corporate and product communications, executive visibility, disease awareness initiatives, and internal communications. title: Corporate Development Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2 id="an-overview-of-this-role" data-lfile-container="21ea07e5-ded4-47e8-ad92-4ca7b7d6be35" data-pm-slice="1 1 []">An overview of this role</h2> <p>As the Corporate Development Director, you'll help influence how GitLab invests to win: what we build, what we buy, where we partner, and what we should not pursue. This role sits within the Corporate Development &amp; Strategic Partnerships team, reporting to the VP, Corporate Development &amp; Strategic Partnerships.</p> <p>This role straddles strategy and M&amp;A engagements. You'll lead research that frames GitLab's options: mapping the markets in and around our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, testing where we have a right to win, and turning that into clear recommendations for the executive team. When the answer is to acquire, you'll drive the deal process end to end, from outreach through close and integration.</p> <p>Success here is not measured by deal count. It looks like sharper strategic choices: a well-reasoned point of view on our priority markets, investment theses that product and executive leaders rely on, acquisitions that speed up the roadmap when buying is the right answer, and an educated no when it isn't. You'll own the wider market perspective rather than individual product categories, and work with the team's Analyst on the research behind it.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <h3 id="strategy-and-research">Strategy and research</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own the wider market view.</strong> Research the broader market GitLab competes in, beyond specific product categories: competitive dynamics, AI-native entrants, technology shifts and where value is moving. Collaborate with the team's Analyst on the research and turn the findings into a clear point of view on where GitLab should play.</li> <li><strong>Build an investment thesis for each focus area.</strong> Work with Product and Engineering leaders to define the problems worth solving, the capabilities GitLab needs, and what it would cost in time and money to get there on our own.</li> <li><strong>Own the competitive and landscape view.</strong> Maintain market maps and a current read on GitLab's competitors: their strategy, product direction, positioning, pricing, and M&amp;A and funding activity. Produce competitor analyses that show where we lead, where we're exposed and how rivals are likely to move. Flag shifts by competitors, hyperscalers and AI labs that change our options, and bring the implications to Product and the executive team.</li> <li><strong>Define where GitLab should not play.</strong> Identify adjacencies that dilute focus and markets where the economics or competition work against us. Make the case for a no with the same rigor as a yes.</li> </ul> <h3 id="build-buy-or-partner">Build, buy or partner</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Run the build, buy, partner analysis.</strong> For each strategic gap, compare the options side by side on speed, cost, risk, control and strategic fit, and bring a clear recommendation.</li> <li><strong>Deliver strategic clarity to</strong> <strong>executives and the Board.</strong> Produce short strategy memos/decks and business cases that set out the decision, the trade-offs and what we give up with each path.</li> <li><strong>Feed company strategy and planning.</strong> Bring an outside-in view of the market and the inorganic options available into annual and long-range planning.</li> <li><strong>Work hand in hand with Strategic Partnerships.</strong> When partnering is the right answer, frame the opportunity and hand it to the partnership owner with a clear thesis. When it isn't, explain why.</li> </ul> <h3 id="deal-execution-and-integration">Deal execution and integration</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own end-to-end deal process management.</strong> Validate target fit against GitLab's our target profile, product roadmap and other criteria, and build the acquisition rationale and business case. The Toqan platform serves the whole Prosus portfolio and other connected businesses, which means the backend systems you build here have reach far beyond a single team. You'll join a 12-person engineering team in Amsterdam and work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to ship end-to-end — at pace, without compromising quality.

You are a senior backend engineer who has moved well past following patterns and into setting them. You're comfortable owning architectural decisions on novel infrastructure — the kind where the right answer isn't obvious and the stakes are real. You think in systems, spot failure modes early, and hold a high bar for production quality without letting perfect block good. The 80/20 mindset comes naturally: you know when to go deep and when to ship.

You've likely come from a startup or high-velocity environment where shipping fast wasn't a culture slogan — it was survival. You know how to cut scope without cutting corners, move from zero to production without a safety net, and iterate quickly on systems that are still finding their shape.

You're genuinely curious about the AI and LLM space — not as a trend to track, but as a domain where you've already done hands-on integration work and want to go further. AI tools aren't an afterthought in how you work — you use them daily, whether that's Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex, and you've developed real judgment about where they accelerate work and where they don't. You operate with low ego, share context freely, and thrive in an environment where autonomy and accountability go hand in hand. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.

  • Strong Go programming skills with a track record of building and operating production backend services

  • Hands-on AWS experience — designing, deploying, and operating cloud-native services at scale

  • Familiarity with agentic architectures and protocols such as MCP, A2A

  • A systems mindset, with attention to reliability, scalability, performance and security

  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and production observability

  • A record of working across product and platform teams to deliver outcomes end-to-end

  • Regular, thoughtful use of AI coding tools as part of your development workflow

Nice to haves

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems that use tools and execute multi-step workflows

  • Experience building or maintaining event-sourced systems

  • Python programming skills

  • Experience with AI or ML infrastructure and developer productivity tooling

No two days look exactly the same. You might design a new capability for the agent runtime, improve how models and tools are orchestrated, investigate a production reliability issue, or take an integration from an early prototype to a secure, observable service.

You’ll spend much of your time building in Go, reviewing code and making architectural decisions with the team. You’ll also work closely with product, platform and AI colleagues to shape requirements, test ideas and ship them safely. Along the way, you’ll improve the testing, deployment and observability foundations that let the team move quickly with confidence.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, commuting, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. In order to acquire, develop and retain customer relationships and create a winning Ping business, this leader will be able to create and maintain a high-performance culture, that is grounded in data, transparency, accountability, and agility. The ideal candidate's mindset should be customer-focused, people-oriented, open, passionate, and authentic. 

Responsibilities:

  • Creates, implements, measures and reviews a strategic or operational plan that drives achievement of business goals aligned to overall Ping strategy
  • Uses mechanisms such as territory planning, account plans, opportunity inspection, pipeline management, account reviews, forecast calls, etc.
  • Advises and coaches the sales team around how to position and articulate Ping Identity's value proposition at enterprise customers, thus increasing the average deal size
  • Identifies and pursues opportunities to expand business activities within areas of responsibility
  • Leverages GSIs & other partners to help source, develop and progress business
  • Plans and controls the expense associated with the area of responsibility even if not responsible for overall cost center
  • Establishes working relationships with external parties which supports the achievement of business goals
  • Is conversant with Ping Identity's systems and procedures and ensures effective use of and conformance to standard business practices and tools (i.e. SFDC – SalesForce.com)
  • Communicates Ping Identity's vision and aligns team and personal goals to achieve business results
  • Provides direction and guidance, mentoring and development of the field team
  • Lives teamwork and promotes cross-functional collaboration
  • Recruits, builds and develops the team to deliver business results; Identifies, develops and promotes high potential employees
  • Recommends and/or approves people-related decisions – hiring, promotions, merit increases, rewards & recognition, training initiatives, etc.
  • Drives performance review and development planning process with annual and quarterly review meetings
  • Has established multi-vertical C level contacts in large enterprise customers
  • Has an established partner/SI network and is used to working with partners on projects
  • Builds relationships with customers (internal or external) as necessary providing customer escalation management as necessary for problem resolution
  • Provides support for customer relationship management as necessary and drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction
  • Drives initiatives which result in improvement in customer satisfaction

 

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Proven experience of successfully leading sales teams focused on the Nordics & Eastern Europe
  • Expertise in enterprise software, SaaS, managed services and strategic account management
  • Results-oriented with multiple years meeting or exceeding quota
  • Flexibility to travel to across the regions
  • Transitioned a team through on-prem to SaaS solutions
  • Adept working in a fast-growing global organization
  • Good interpersonal skills to align and foster positive working relationships across the organization
  • Eligibility to work in the Netherlands or Norway

 

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Business Development Representative
description: What do we do? Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better. We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally. The Role: We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before. As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings. This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle. What you'll do: Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us. Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts. Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.). Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team. Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand. Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance. Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets. Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day. We'd love to hear from you if you are: Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone. Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results. Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different. Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets. See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value. Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity. Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity. Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft. Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social. Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales. Everyone is welcome at Paddle At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group. Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together. Our Values Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us” Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple” Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs” Why you’ll love working at Paddle We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture. raw.title: Business Development Representative
raw.description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.


The Role:

We are looking for a smart, ambitious, and autonomous Business Development Representative to help fuel our next stage of hyper-growth. This is an exciting time for you to join the team: our customer base is expanding globally, our product is evolving fast, and our sales engine is scaling like never before.

As a BDR in our Business Development team, you will be the first point of contact for all of Paddle’s sales efforts. You’ll create demand, spark meaningful conversations, and build early relationships that turn into qualified pipeline to arm your counterparts on the Account Executive team. Your core tasks will involve researching, prospecting, prioritizing accounts, educating prospects, and converting interest into high-quality meetings.

This role places you at the centre of a high-performing GTM function. We take career development seriously. Once you consistently hit quota and master the craft, you’ll have a clear pathway to grow into an Account Executive role at Paddle.


What you'll do:

  • Quickly develop a deep understanding of Paddle’s Ideal Customer Profile, core use cases, and value propositions to target the best-fit companies for us.

  • Own and properly manage a healthy territory of high-fit accounts.

  • Proactively generate conversations and effectively showcase Paddle’s set of products across all channels: LinkedIn, cold calling, email, video, and region-specific channels (WhatsApp, WeChat, etc.).

  • Convert these meaningful engagements into qualified opportunities for our Account Executive team.

  • Partner with our marketing department to collaborate on in-person and virtual events to generate demand.

  • Use modern tools, including AI-powered workflows, to work smarter, personalise outreach, and improve performance.

  • Manage and prioritise your time to consistently meet and exceed your targets.

  • Bring a winner’s mindset and high-performance attitude to the team every day.


We'd love to hear from you if you are:

  • Experience in a previous Sales / Business Development role as part of a SaaS or B2B company, and are always happy to proactively engage new customers through email and phone.

  • Coachable, accountable, and consistent in your efforts to develop knowledge and results.

  • Believe in a consultative and human sales approach and understand that every conversation is different.

  • Are performance-driven, competitive, and energised by hitting and surpassing targets.

  • See the benefits of Paddle’s set of products - we strongly believe that our products are helping other Tech companies grow, and we want to work with people who are passionate about Paddle and can articulate its value.

  • Can stay organised in a dynamic, fast-changing environment and thrive in moments of ambiguity.

  • Can follow a framework, while baking in your own flavour and creativity.

  • Are excited to get outside your comfort zone, experiment, and continuously improve your craft.

  • Are confident communicating across multiple channels and formats: phone, email, video, social.

  • Enthusiastic and ambitious, with a desire to build a career in sales.


Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.


Our Values

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

 

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We are a diverse, growing group of Paddlers across the globe who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We are a ‘digital-first’ company, which means you can work remotely, from one of our stylish hubs, or even a bit of both! We offer all team members unlimited holidays and 4 months paid family leave regardless of gender. We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Nebius:</strong></p> <p>Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.</p> <p>Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.</p> <p>Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&amp;D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&amp;D.</p></div><h2>The role</h2> <p>As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer on&nbsp;the Applied AI team at Nebius Token Factory,&nbsp;you will own model and endpoint optimization from model artifacts through production deployment. You will evaluate model- and engine-level optimizations together with distributed inference designs, including request routing, scheduling, prefill/decode coordination, and multi-node GPU execution. Your improvements will be validated through&nbsp;reproducible benchmarks and safe production&nbsp;rollouts under real-world workloads.</p> <h2>Your responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own optimization&nbsp;projects&nbsp;for specific model families, customer endpoints, or serving backends.</li> <li>Compare inference engines&nbsp;and recommend serving configurations&nbsp;suited to individual&nbsp;workloads.</li> <li>Diagnose model-quality and&nbsp;performance regressions during production rollouts.</li> <li>Improve&nbsp;LLM and VLM&nbsp;endpoint&nbsp;latency, throughput, memory efficiency, GPU utilization, quality, and cost per token.</li> <li>Deploy, configure, benchmark, and extend engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server,&nbsp;and NVIDIA Dynamo.</li> <li>Develop production model-compression workflows covering&nbsp;quantization, quantization-aware training, distillation, low-bit serving, and accuracy recovery.</li> <li>Implement or integrate speculative decoding, draft-model approaches, KV-cache optimization, prefix caching, chunked prefill, continuous batching, and disaggregated prefill/decode serving.&nbsp;For prefill–decode disaggregation (PDD), evaluate KV-cache transfer, worker placement, and capacity balancing to determine which workloads benefit from the architecture.</li> <li>Design and improve LLM request routers and scheduling policies that balance worker utilization, queueing, request characteristics, and KV-cache locality while meeting latency and reliability targets.</li> <li>Scale dense and mixture-of-experts inference across multiple GPU nodes. Select and tune tensor, pipeline, data, and expert parallelism—including wide expert parallelism (WideEP)—with attention to hardware topology, expert load balance, and communication overhead.</li> <li>Build reproducible benchmark harnesses&nbsp;measuring&nbsp;TTFT, TPOT, tokens per second per GPU, p95/p99 latency, GPU memory, reliability, and cost per token.&nbsp;Validate architecture choices under representative traffic and consistent GPU budgets.</li> <li>Collaborate&nbsp;with GPU kernel and platform engineers to&nbsp;trace&nbsp;bottlenecks across model code, kernels, runtime, scheduler, gateway, and cluster layers.</li> <li>Produce design documents,&nbsp;performance reports, rollout plans, and customer-facing technical explanations.</li> </ul> <h2>Must-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Strong&nbsp;engineering skills in Python and PyTorch.</li> <li>Hands-on experience deploying or optimizing LLM, VLM, or high-throughput transformer&nbsp;inference.</li> <li>Practical knowledge of at least one modern inference&nbsp;stack,&nbsp;such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, NVIDIA Dynamo, Ray Serve, KServe, or&nbsp;an equivalent internal system.</li> <li>A strong&nbsp;understanding of transformer inference&nbsp;bottlenecks involving&nbsp;KV cache, attention, memory bandwidth, batching, parallelism, and long-context serving.</li> <li>Ability to&nbsp;quantify trade-offs among&nbsp;latency, throughput, quality, utilization, and&nbsp;cost.</li> <li>Experience designing or optimizing distributed inference system architecture, with hands-on work in one or more areas such as request routing, distributed scheduling, PDD, multi-node inference, or expert parallelism.</li> <li>Strong communication and&nbsp;collaboration skills across&nbsp;research, kernel, infrastructure, product, and customer teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-haves</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, FP8, INT8, INT4, NVFP4, MXFP4, AWQ, GPTQ, or&nbsp;SmoothQuant.</li> <li>Experience with distillation, speculative decoding, EAGLE, Medusa, multi-token prediction, or&nbsp;related&nbsp;inference acceleration methods.</li> <li>Experience&nbsp;supporting agentic workloads involving&nbsp;tool calling, structured outputs, streaming APIs, high concurrency, and multi-step orchestration.</li> <li>Familiarity with CUDA or Triton; the role does not require kernel engineering to be the candidate’s primary specialization.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects such as&nbsp;vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, FlashInfer, LMCache, PyTorch, Triton, Ray, or&nbsp;KServe.</li> <li>Implementation experience with cache-aware request routing, PDD, or WideEP, including diagnosing communication bottlenecks and load imbalance.</li> <li>Familiarity with GPU communication libraries and interconnects, such as NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, or RoCE.</li> </ul><div title: Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover
description: About Volta Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds. About The Role Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams. You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live. Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it. What You Will Be Doing Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service. Build and lead the global Commissioning and Handover team, covering electrical, mechanical and CDU commissioning standards, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence. Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations. Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service. Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through tohandover. Set the facilities readiness and operational readiness standards and governance, so each facility is ready for operations and the operations team is ready to run it. Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training. Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site. Report commissioning progress and risk across sites, and feed lessons learned back into the standards and the reference design. What You Bring Experience leading commissioning of hyperscale data centres, including electrical, mechanical and liquid cooling systems. Data centre experience is essential. A track record owning commissioning and handover across multiple concurrent sites at this level, and the ability to run it from day one. Deep knowledge of commissioning levels, integrated systems testing and the turn-up sequence for high density GPU environments. Experience with CDU and liquid cooling commissioning and handover into operations. Experience setting readiness governance and handing live facilities over to operations teams. Experience building and leading commissioning teams and managing commissioning agents and contractors. Understanding of physical and systems security requirements in mission critical facilities. Willingness to travel to sites across Europe and North America. 263 What We Offer At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of. As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do. Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success Retirement/pension contributions Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits Generous number of vacation days each year Additional Information Background Checks All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law. Equal Opportunity Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. Accessibility Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at Candidate Privacy Notice By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role

Commissioning is where an AI factory becomes real. As Senior Director, Global Commissioning & Handover, you will lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network across all of Volta's sites, taking each one to ready for service and handing it over to our operations teams.

You will build and lead a global team that owns Volta's commissioning standards for electrical, mechanical and CDU scopes, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness. Your team sets how commissioning is done on every site, from tagging through to the turn-up sequence, and holds the schedule that takes each facility live.

Time to market matters here. You will align commissioning to the turn-up sequence so that commissioning accelerates service rather than delays it, and you will make sure that when a building is handed over, the operations team, the procedures and the systems are ready to run it.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead commissioning of DSX facilities and network infrastructure across Volta's AI factories, taking each site to ready for service.

  • Build and lead the global Commissioning and Handover team, covering electrical, mechanical and CDU commissioning standards, systems security, commissioning planning, facilities readiness and operational readiness.

  • Own Volta's commissioning standards for each discipline, from tagging and method statements through each commissioning level to the turn-up sequence.

  • Own CDU installation and commissioning standards, including handover to operations.

  • Own the commissioning schedule for every site and its alignment to turn-up, so that commissioning is never the critical path to service.

  • Deliver the physical and systems security requirements for each site from construction through tohandover.

  • Set the facilities readiness and operational readiness standards and governance, so each facility is ready for operations and the operations team is ready to run it.

  • Lead handover into service, working with DC Operations on acceptance, documentation and training.

  • Work with Design and Engineering, the regional delivery teams and the DSX execution and network teams so commissioning is integrated into the master schedule on every site.

  • Report commissioning progress and risk across sites, and feed lessons learned back into the standards and the reference design.

What You Bring

  • Experience leading commissioning of hyperscale data centres, including electrical, mechanical and liquid cooling systems. Data centre experience is essential.

  • A track record owning commissioning and handover across multiple concurrent sites at this level, and the ability to run it from day one.

  • Deep knowledge of commissioning levels, integrated systems testing and the turn-up sequence for high density GPU environments.

  • Experience with CDU and liquid cooling commissioning and handover into operations.

  • Experience setting readiness governance and handing live facilities over to operations teams.

  • Experience building and leading commissioning teams and managing commissioning agents and contractors.

  • Understanding of physical and systems security requirements in mission critical facilities.

  • Willingness to travel to sites across Europe and North America.

title: Scientific Product Manager
description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform. Your impact This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data. What You Will Do Product Requirements & Roadmap Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team. Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance. Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems. Partner Lab Onboarding Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter. Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster. Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences. Closed-Loop Campaigns Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples. Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research. Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia. Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab. Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning. Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others. Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas. Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams. Bonus Points (But Not Critical): Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments. Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope). Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration. Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product. Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab. Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries. Additional Considerations This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world. CuspAI is an equal opportunities employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace . What You Will Do

Product Requirements & Roadmap

  • Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

  • Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

Partner Lab Onboarding

  • Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

  • Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

  • Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

Closed-Loop Campaigns

  • Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

  • Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

  • PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

  • Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

  • Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

raw.title: Carrier Account Executive
raw.description:
Description

Do you have experience managing carrier networks and want to directly impact commercial success? At CtrlChain, we’re looking for a driven Carrier Account Executive to expand and optimize our carrier network across Europe. 

About us 

Over the past eight years, CtrlChain has built a powerful and trusted ecosystem to simplify and modernize the transport and logistics sector. Now, we're making this ecosystem fully available to our customers, both shippers and carriers. 

Our system brings digital transformation to an industry long reliant on outdated processes, offering smart tools that enhance visibility, streamline compliance, and optimize operations. The result? A more efficient, transparent, and effortless way of working for everyone involved! 

We’re growing fast and expanding our carrier network across Europe. As our network grows, the Carrier Team plays a key role in ensuring carriers are onboarded, activated in our systems, and ready to support our commercial growth. 

The role 

As a Carrier Account Executive, you own a portfolio of carriers and play a key role in expanding capacity, improving margins, and supporting Sales in winning new business. 

You actively build and improve the carrier network, ensuring we have the right capacity, performance, and competitiveness to support growth. You play a key role in improving automation, service KPIs, margins, and win-rate. 

What you’ll do 

Build and scale the carrier network 

  • Proactively expand the carrier base for existing and new lanes  
  • Ensure strong capacity coverage aligned with business needs  
  • Identify and onboard new carriers to improve competitiveness  

Drive onboarding & automation 

  • Onboard and activate carriers in CtrlChain systems  
  • Ensure full system adoption and drive a system-first way of working  
  • Increase automation by ensuring carriers use all relevant tools  

Support Sales & improve win-rate 

  • Work closely with Sales on RFPs and new business  
  • Provide competitive carrier solutions and fast turnaround  
  • Contribute directly to improving win-rate  

Optimize performance & margins 

  • Monitor carrier KPIs and proactively drive improvements  
  • Improve service performance (reliability, responsiveness)  
  • Optimize carrier selection to improve margins  

Deliver insights & improve decisions 

  • Ensure carrier data is accurate, complete, and usable  
  • Provide insights to support pricing, planning, and strategy  
  • Identify structural gaps and improvement opportunities in the network 

Requirements

Who You Are 

You’re commercially aware, proactive, and comfortable working at the intersection of operations and Sales. 

You will thrive in this role if you: 

  • Have 5–8 years of experience in transport, freight forwarding, or logistics coordination. 
  • Have experience with carrier onboarding, communication, and daily operations.  
  • Take a proactive approach to expanding carrier capacity on existing and new lanes.  
  • Are comfortable working with KPIs and continuously improving performance (service, responsiveness, reliability).  
  • Have a system-first mindset and ensure tools are used effectively.  
  • Understand how your work impacts Sales win-rate, margins, and competitiveness.  
  • Are structured, responsive, and take ownership. 
  • Professional level of English and Dutch.
  • Third European language is preferred (ideally German, French, Polish). 

 

Why join CtrlChain? 

  • Direct impact on win-rate, margins, and growth  
  • High ownership and autonomy  
  • Work closely with Sales and commercial teams  
  • Fast-paced scale-up environment  

Benefits

What We Offer 

✔ Competitive salary & benefits
✔ 26 vacation days
✔ Fully paid pension plan & travel allowance
✔ Vitality Allowance & daily office lunches
✔ A high-performance, collaborative sales culture
✔ The opportunity to shape the future of digital logistics

Ready to Join Us? 

Apply now and grow your career as a Carrier Account Executive at CtrlChain!

description: Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien. Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging. Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit. Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties. Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn. In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken. Nieuwsgierigheid, leergierigheid en technische diepgang vinden we belangrijker dan een perfecte checklist. Over BigData Republic BigData Republic is een high-end consultancybureau gespecialiseerd in data science, data engineering en machine learning. We zijn AI-native en combineren dit met diepgaande engineering kennis. Op deze manier bieden wij onze klanten technische begeleiding tot duurzame en innovatieve oplossingen. Als niche-consultancyteam onderscheiden we ons van de grote spelers: we leveren kwaliteit boven kwantiteit en willen een thought leader in ons vakgebied zijn. Voor onze klanten richten we ons op het creëren van businesswaarde met innovatieve datasolutions die een duurzame impact hebben. Kennisdeling en thought leadership zijn fundamentele pijlers van onze organisatie: elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogposts, organiseren meetups en bezoeken conferenties. Bij BigData Republic kun je dé expert in de ruimte zijn, en tegelijkertijd elke dag iets nieuws leren van je collega's. title: Projectleider Cybersecurity Congres | RDI
description: Omschrijving Wij zijn voor de Rijksinspectie Digitale Infrastructuur (RDI ) op zoek naar een ervaren Projectleider . De RDI zet zich in voor een veilig verbonden Nederland en werkt aan actuele thema’s zoals cyberveiligheid, digitale weerbaarheid, AI, 5G en digitale infrastructuur. De opdracht vindt plaats binnen de directie Digitale Weerbaarheid en richt zich op de organisatie van de NISDUC 2027 (NIS Directive User Community), een internationaal congres op het gebied van digitale weerbaarheid, cybersecurity en toezicht. Tijdens dit congres komen toezichthouders, overheden en professionals uit Nederland, België en Luxemburg samen om kennis en ervaringen uit te wisselen rondom onder meer NIS2 en cybersecurity. Als Projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en organisatorische aansturing van het congres en zorg je voor een succesvolle realisatie van het programma en de samenwerking met alle betrokken partijen. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Je voert de projectleiding over het volledige programma van NISDUC 2027. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de organisatie van het internationale cybersecuritycongres. Je ontwikkelt, beheert en vult de verschillende programmalijnen en tracks. Je stemt af met betrokken overheidsorganisaties, toezichthouders en partners. Je organiseert internationale kennisuitwisseling en samenwerking binnen het congresprogramma. Je stuurt het betrokken evenementenbureau aan. Je bewaakt planning, kwaliteit, voortgang en resultaten van het congres. Je draagt zorg voor een professioneel en inhoudelijk sterk programma rondom digitale weerbaarheid en cybersecurity Wat vragen wij? Eisen: Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-opleiding. Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als projectleider. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen het cybersecuritydomein. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met het aansturen van de organisatie van inhoudelijke congressen. Je hebt ervaring met complexe opdrachten en omvangrijke trajecten met een hoog afbreukrisico. Je bent in het bezit van een projectmanagementcertificering. Aanvullende wensen: Je hebt ervaring als projectleider binnen de Rijksoverheid. Je hebt ervaring met het organiseren van cybersecurity-events. Je hebt ervaring met samenwerkingspartners binnen het cybersecuritydomein, zoals het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC). Competenties Je bent bestuurlijk sensitief. Je bent communicatief sterk. Je bent creatief in het ontwikkelen van programma’s en oplossingen. Je beschikt over organisatiesensitiviteit. Je weet verschillende belangen effectief samen te brengen. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van een publieke organisatie en beweegt je gemakkelijk binnen een complexe stakeholderomgeving. Informatie  Start: 2 november 2026 Aantal uur: 16 tot 20 uur per week Lengte opdracht: 8 maanden Locatie: Amersfoort Vorm: ZZP Schaalniveau: 14 Geïnteresseerd? Graag ontvangen wij jouw CV voor maandag 26 oktober 9.00 uur met contactgegevens en de beschikbaarheid. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products. Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan. Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps. Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes. Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked. Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders. Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control. Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients. YOU Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field. At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products. A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues. Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues. Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.
